verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal is an API-driven payments product, so scoped agent credentials are a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack never documents restricted keys, per-permission scoping, or least-privilege credential issuance. The MCP server, CLI and agent-tooling items cover agent connectivity, not credential scoping, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
